![](asset:P000552-stem-1)A block of mass 5 kg is placed on a fixed plane inclined at $37{^\circ}$ with the horizontal as shown. Find:
(i) Friction force acting on the block
(ii) The contact force acting on the block
(iii) Minimum force F acting along the slope required to make the block move down the slope
(iv) Minimum force F acting along the slope required to make the block move up the slope

assets.alt: A 5 kg block resting on a rough incline of 37° with μ = 1.
A block on a 37° incline: weight 50 N down, normal N = 40 N and friction f = 30 N up the slope. Note: f_max = μN = 40 N > 30 N, so static friction f = 30 N.
